notes.title: Development Branch Update 0.2.6
notes.content:
Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed FPS camera to work as expected and users should no longer see teeth when they're 
in first person mode. 
[*]Fixed issues with storage units not syncing to the correct storage
[/list]

Changes
[list]
[*]Changed how monsters spawn from spawning on top of the user around them to spawning
to any spawning node around a user within 1/2 km this will help users not be overwhelmed when 
playing,
[/list]

notes.title: Development Branch Alpha 0.2.5
notes.content:
Development Branch Change Logs

Game Balance Changes
[list]
[*]Increased respawn time for resources from 15 seconds to 10 minutes
[/list]

Additional Features
[list]

[*]Added arrow recipe

notes.title: Development Branch Alpha 0.2.5
notes.content:
Fixes
[list]
[*]Copper furnace recipe didn't have a output to the copper furnace so would show up as nothing
added it 
[*]survival mask didn't have a drop model added it
[*]fixed survival plating drop model to be just chest plat model on the ground
[/list]

notes.title: Development Branch Alpha 0.2.4
notes.content:
Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed Long load times due to massive amount of resourced loaded into memory. 
[*]Fixed Huge Lag spikes due to resources in memory being streamed in during gameplay and 
iterating through those objects
[/list]


Additional Features
[list]
[*]separated networking level from the map scene so we load the map in the background
[*]load in resource nodes as needed
[*]game now has dynamic resources loaded in as users explore around the map and users make a call to the game server to request resources to be spawned in. 
[/list]

notes.title: Development Branch Alpha 0.2.3
notes.content:
Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed Ai spawning on the navmesh
[*]Fixed Error caused by a player null reference for smelter script
[*]Fixed Issue where leaving the game and returning from the menu broke it. 
[/list]

Additional Features
[list]
[*]Removed forest trees that are not interactable
[*]Removed most vegetation and created a plains
[*]Added stone axe to help users chop down wood
[*]Added wood Resource. 
[*]Removed all items from player's inventory and gave starting gear
[*]Placed starting survival knife in first hotbar slot instead of the player's inventory
[/list]

Game Balance Changes
[list]
[*]Increased HP for Tree from 100hp to 600hp
[*]Increased all mobs health by a factor of 4 so mobs don't die to single knife hits
[*]Added DR of 3 to mobs as they would have some protection against users
[*]Increased rate of spawning for mobs from 60 seconds min and 180 max to 3 seconds min and 60 max
[/list]

Recipe Changes
[list]
[*]Increased the cost of railgun rifle 
[*]Increased the cost of laser rifle
[*]Increased the cost of all pistols
[/list]

notes.title: Development Branch Alpha 0.2.2
notes.content:
Development Branch Change Logs

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed UI to have only Single Player Button so users can play the game immediately
[/list]

Additional Features
[list]
[*]Added Chill Kid's Latest War of Gaia track to main menu and main game loop. 
[*]Added Iron Ingot Furnace to craft iron ingots
[*]Furnaces don't require power cores and only takes ore
[*]Added interact script to furnace so player can deposit ore from a single place
[/list]

Recipe Changes
[list]
[*]Added back to the iron ingot recipe the need for power core
[*]Set crafting times for hand made ingots from 10 seconds to 100 seconds
[*]Set furnace crafting times from 1 second each to 10 seconds
[/list]

notes.title: First Major Update
notes.content: Our first major update will hit this Friday. We're excited to bring new updates and features to this game and to our fans. Major updates will be pushed every 1st of the month with bug fixes / patches following each release so feedback is more than welcomed. We look forward to continued support for this game and all our titles to come. Thanks for support!

notes.title: Patch Note May 12th
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] 4k Resolution Support and UI Scaling
[*] Water now stops vehicles from moving
[*] Tree colliders fixed
[*] Inventory Pickup Prompt to notify inventory pickup
[*] UI Fixes for Main menu
[*] Added Pickaxe as default melee tool
[*] Removed reflective probes that caused graphical glitches
[*]Removed Turret from ground vehicle as wasn't working properly
[/list]


Known Issues to be addressed 
[list]
[*]Vehicle Camera now Fixed instead of orbit but has jerky motion
[*]Vehicle Camera isn't rendering water correctly
[*]Engine sounds even though Vehicle has been disabled by water
[*]NPC not spawning Correctly in game
[/list]

notes.title: Awesome Feedback and Course Corrections.
notes.content:
We've gotten some feedback on our product and we've resolved some of the issues brought to our attention. We'll push out a update as soon as we resolve a few more today. Thank you for your continued support! 
[b]
Things we addressed[/b]
[list]
[*]4k Resolution Support for UI elements
[*]Prompts for weapon pick-ups
[*]Removed Respawn Menu and put users in escape-pod
[*]Fixed Tree colliders
[*]Water now makes things float and act as expected
[*]Replaced Knife with Pickaxe
[/list]


[b]Things we're Going to address Today and throughout this week[/b]
[list]
[*]Improvements to Build System
[*]Swim Mechanics 
[*]Audio Pass for Music and Sounds
[/list]


Throughout the month we'll be working towards a new major update to the base game. After each release we're spending the week to address issues that arise. We appreciate constructive criticism and we'll work towards making a better product with each passing month. We're a small but dedicated team and we look forward to the future.  Feel Free to join our discord to reach out about our product. [url=https://discord.gg/xHhCNYy]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Closed Alpha Testers and Beyond
notes.content:
War of Gaia is officially going to be available on steam May 10th 2019. It's currently available to closed alpha testers who already have the keys now. 

This in the game now
[list]
[*] Multiplayer
[*] Base Building
[*] Vehicles
[*] Weapon system
[/list]


[h1]Sneak Peek at our next update to the game[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34853314/16df9cdaead1be788e23bb2e4798e9ce4c87b396.png[/img]

Updates we are planning to launch every major update on the 1st of each month. Based on feedback and bug reports we'll work hard to bring a awesome experience to all our users. 

Direct any questions , comments , concerns on our forums so we can make a note of it.

If you're part of the closed alpha go ahead and download the game and start ganking each other ,also if anyone has time find bugs so we can squash them. We appreciate your support and we're building not just a game but a community.

We're excited to bring to you an amazing product and awesome updates as we venture with you on this journey of game development and everyone gets to have a hand in it's development as we go forward. We here at Funatic Illuminations look forward to everyone's input and we hope to see you in the Gaiaverse!
